# Multi-agent teams

**Split work across researcher, writer, reviewer and capped trader agents with hand-offs, shared state and human approval gates.**

Splits an agent's work across a small team of agents — researcher, writer, reviewer, publisher and a trader with hard caps — with written hand-offs, one place for shared state, a clear rule for who may spend or post (only the human approves), review gates, budgets and stop rules. Shows the tool split with Claudia's tool catalog, separate local MCP servers per role, Claudia Local's helper agents and the shared spend ledger. Use when one agent is doing too much, when adding a reviewer or a trading role, when designing an orchestrator and sub-agents, or when agents on a team start passing instructions to each other.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Build](../README.md) | advanced | 1–2 h to design, 30 min to wire | `@useclaudia/sdk`, `@useclaudia/mcp`, `@useclaudia/social`, `@useclaudia/cli`, `claudia-local` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Write the job as a pipeline
2. Give each role the fewest tools
3. Fence roles at the server, not only the prompt
4. Hand off with a written brief
5. Keep shared state in one place
6. Put review gates between stages
7. Decide who may spend and post
8. Set budgets and stop rules
9. Replay before going live

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/multi-agent-teams.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/multi-agent-teams.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/multi-agent-teams.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/multi-agent-teams.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill multi-agent-teams`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `multi-agent-teams.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/multi-agent-teams`.
